privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.personalInfoCollectedValue: User registration information (email address, etc.), cookie and access analysis information (Google Analytics, etc.). We do not store voice files uploaded by users or transcription results on our servers. They are deleted immediately upon completion of processing.
privacyPolicy.purposeOfUseValue: Providing the service, user authentication, billing, statistical analysis for service improvement (conducted in a manner that does not identify individuals), responding to inquiries, and distributing important notices.
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyDisclosureValue: We will not disclose personal information to third parties without the user's consent, except as required by law.
privacyPolicy.securityMeasuresValue: We implement TLS communication encryption, access permission management, and log monitoring.
privacyPolicy.requestsDisclosure: Requests for Disclosure, Correction, or Deletion

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.timePlanValue: No refunds will be issued after purchase.
refundPolicy.subscriptionValue: Cancellation must be made at least 24 hours before the next billing date via My Page. No prorated refunds or refunds for remaining periods will be issued.
refundPolicy.systemOutagesValue: If our services are interrupted for 48 consecutive hours or more due to our gross negligence, we will either extend the service period free of charge for the duration of the outage or provide a credit equivalent to the value of the outage period.
